items.title: Nvidia shares tumble over investigation into Huang's affair with alleged Chinese spy
novel_facts: Nvidia shares fell ~4%, wiping about $250bn off market value
Trump called Huang an 'honourable guy' and Musk voiced support
Huang requested to appear for closed-door joint Congressional committee briefing next week
Analyst commentary (Victoria Fernandez) on Huang's vulnerable position given low ownership stake and single-class voting structure
items.reason: This covers the same Nvidia/Huang espionage-affair investigation as the canonical article, but adds a material market reaction (share price drop, $250bn value loss) and updated details on Congressional briefing timing and executive/political reactions, which are updates to the same ongoing story rather than a separate newsworthy angle.
